page.layout: One page of text, one column. Woodcut ornament strip at the top, above the heading. Heading centred in capitals with the addressee line below it. Body text in one column, then the signature "ELIÆ" set right-aligned at the foot. No margin notes.

p.i: Clarorum virorum lucubrationes literarias posteris typo descriptas tradere, & illorum interest & reipublicæ. Nam nec in obscuro jacere famam eorum qui præclara ingenii sui monumenta erigenda condiderunt, æquum est, nec rempublicam literariam egregio subsidio privari. Cum igitur in manus meas inciderit Clarissimi Viri Eliæ Reusneri coronâ immortali dignum Coronarum opus, calamo exaratum, edito in lucem Hortulo quibusdam in locis auctius, consilio cum Typographo habito, virgam censoriam parcè adhibui, ut iterata editione luce frue-retur: pauca vel imprudenter in magnates dicta vel odiosè repetita detraxi: pauca præ-terea vel immutavi vel adjunxi, prout elegantiæ verborum aut rationi sententiarum consultum iri speraham. Sic plane egi cum eorum qui hinc in Locum communem abierunt posthumo labore, ut mea, si quid humanitus mihi acciderit, ab alijs accipi optarem. Vale Lector benevole & conatibus nostris favē. Scholarum & tyronum usui provirili à nobis consulitur: veteranos & exauctoratos non morantur. Dabam Herbornæ:anno 1651.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament strip at the top and the library stamp "Staatsbibliothek Regensburg" at the foot are not transcribed. Words "speraham" and "adjunxi" were read at small size; "speraham" should be checked against "sperabam" (the printed form appears to be "speraham"; copied as seen). Possible small reference mark or pointer near "pauca præ-" in the line above "terea"; not clearly legible and not transcribed. Italic: the whole body is set in italic, marked as one passage. "frue-retur" is a word split at a line end with a printed hyphen.
